method: Original health command handlers with real numeric parameter and message list lookup. Only named-character callback, bounded CRT sprintf string formatting, and downstream hit call are adapters; command token parsing, numeric conversion and message lookup run unmodified.
limits: Named resolver is an explicit fixture callback, not reconstructed world lookup.
TakeDamage final hit is recorded; no damage engine side effects in this suite.
Message list contains one authored-style named float record and no free records; full message allocation is not asserted.
Bounded finite parameter values; original numeric code runs without hooks.
